evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.
Is the current membership of K2_C0001 positively represented as an independent unit relative to the full current partition in the multimodal patient geometry?
Is the current membership of K2_C0002 positively represented as an independent unit relative to the full current partition in the multimodal patient geometry?
Does K2_C0001 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Does K2_C0002 show a coherent and interpretable biological phenotype or molecular program relative to the appropriate comparison population?
Is the current boundary between K2_C0001 and K2_C0002 represented in the multimodal patient geometry, or is the pair better described as a single weakly separated unit?

actions.reason: K2_C0002 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (coordinated down-regulation of OXPHOS, immune/inflammatory, DNA repair, ROS, MTORC1 programs with reciprocal up-regulation of developmental signaling; NES to ~-2.29, many pathways FDR q<0.01) per the set-scope biological_support report. Its exact-set membership representation is positively supported: current-label alignment is positive in all four native geometries (CT 0.069, RNA 0.096, WSI 0.204, WXS 0.275) with low negative fractions and within-distance below between-distance in every modality. The pair-scope boundary report shows only weak boundary separation, but weak boundary alone does not recommend merge, and merge is not a permitted structural action here; the pair report is accounted for and does not overturn the positive set-scope membership representation.

K2_C0001 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (up-regulation of OXPHOS and immune/inflammatory programs, down-regulation of developmental signaling), but its exact-set membership representation is not positively supported: current-label alignment is weak and modality-dependent, with negative mean silhouettes in CT (-0.035), WSI (-0.083), and WXS (-0.069) and substantial negative fractions, and within-distance at or above between-distance in those modalities; only RNA is weakly positive (0.063). The pair-scope boundary report shows the K2_C0001|K2_C0002 boundary is only weakly expressed, but weak boundary alone does not justify merge, and merge is not a permitted structural action in this workflow. Partition-level structural screening reports candidate_k=1 with no internal subdivision signal, and no internal-subdivision evidence was requested or reported, so no plausible structural alternative remains. Independent retention of K2_C0001 is therefore unsupported.
